parameters.jsCode:
const plan=$('Code | Select Qdrant Mutations | QdrantLoader').first().json;const resp=$input.first()?.json||{};const rows=Array.isArray(resp.result)?resp.result:[];const byId=new Map(rows.map(x=>[String(x.id),x]));let instructionVerified=0;for(const item of plan.preparedItems){const row=byId.get(String(item.pointId));if(!row) throw new Error(`Qdrant loader read-back missing ${item.pointId}`);const p=row.payload||{};if(String(p.principalKey||'')!==String(plan.principalKey)||String(p.tenantId||'')!==String(plan.tenantId)) throw new Error(`Qdrant loader tenant isolation mismatch ${item.pointId}`);if(String(p.contentHash||'')!==String(item.payload.contentHash)) throw new Error(`Qdrant loader content hash mismatch ${item.pointId}`);if(String(p.sourceText||'')!==String(item.sourceText)) throw new Error(`Qdrant loader semantic text mismatch ${item.pointId}`);for(const k of ['memoryKind','fact','predicateKey','scopeKey','semanticKey','pointType']){if(item.payload[k]!==undefined&&JSON.stringify(p[k])!==JSON.stringify(item.payload[k]))throw new Error(`Qdrant loader payload flatten mismatch ${k}:${item.pointId}`);}if(String(item.payload.memoryKind||'').toLowerCase()==='triggered_instruction'){if(String(p.instructionId||'')!==String(item.payload.instructionId)||String(p.sourceAnswerMessageId||'')!==String(item.payload.sourceAnswerMessageId)||String(p.assistantArtifactHash||'').replace(/^sha256:/,'').toLowerCase()!==String(item.payload.assistantArtifactHash||'').replace(/^sha256:/,'').toLowerCase())throw new Error(`Qdrant loader instruction provenance mismatch ${item.pointId}`);instructionVerified++;}}
const indexed=plan.selectedPoints.map(x=>String(x.id));return [{json:{...plan,status:'done',preparedFileCount:plan.preparedFileCount,selectedForIndexingCount:indexed.length,skippedExistingQdrantPointCount:plan.skippedExistingQdrantPointCount,upsertPreparedCount:indexed.length,qdrantReadBackVerifiedCount:plan.preparedItems.length,checkedQdrantPointCount:plan.preparedItems.length,qdrantReadBackStatus:'verified',indexedExamples:indexed.slice(0,20),skippedExamples:plan.skippedExamples||[],qdrantInstructionExpectedCount:Number(plan.instructionExpectedCount||0),qdrantReadBackInstructionVerifiedCount:instructionVerified,runtimeVersion:'chelsea_qdrant_loader_runtime_v2_0',loaderReturnVersion:'chelsea_qdrant_loader_return_v2_0',completedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];
